message.content:
**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000 USD  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $900 000–$950 000 USD  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Value Index” (latest update 2024‑Q2)  
> • Redfin Market Trends – “California Median Home Price” (2024‑Q2)  

> **Note:**  
> - The median figure is the most commonly cited metric for “average” home price because it is less skewed by extremely high‑priced properties.  
> - The mean (average) price is typically higher, reflecting the presence of luxury homes in cities like San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Silicon Valley.  
> - Prices vary widely across counties: e.g., San Francisco County median ≈ $1.5 M, while rural counties may be below $300 K.
